title: ActiveModelSet
description: Schema for specifying the active model set and model versions used during Generator Runtime Prediction.

model_set_id.description: Identifier for the active model set

model_set_version.description: Version string of the active model set

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the pointer was updated

models.description: Map of base model identifiers to their active configuration

required.description: Whether failure of this model fails the entire batch
